name: anniversary-24th
author: akreao
description: kRO's 24th anniversary event from 2026. Visit the 24th Anniversary Coin Exchanger in Prontera once a day for 20 Attendance Boxes, each with a gift and anniversary coins, plus a Gift Box with All in One Potions and a Kafra Buff. Trade the coins for potions, buffs, Tokens of Siegfried, Costume Tris Sword, Costume Tan Spear and a Himmelmez wig in your choice of colour. A setting sends the boxes through the game's Attendance Check window instead, as on kRO. Renewal only.
